quests.title: Daily check-in and quests
quests.r1: Check in once a day: +2 XP. Days in a row build your streak: +10 at 7 days, +20 at 14, +50 at 30 and every 30 after.
quests.r2: Streak freezes: one for every 7 days in a row, up to 2. A missed day uses one instead of breaking your streak.
quests.r3: 3 quests a day: one to visit, one social, one move. +2 XP each, +4 when all 3 are done. One free swap a day.
quests.r4: For wallets with 10,000 $FLYAI (wallet, staked or locked) or a Trader Fly. A new day starts at 00:00 UTC. It counts toward the airdrop.
quests.empty: No streaks yet. Check in to start one.
